sn55.21:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sakkesu viharati kapilavatthusmiṃ nigrodhārāme.
sn55.21:1.3: atha kho mahānāmo sakko yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho mahānāmo sakko bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
sn55.21:1.4: “idaṃ bhante, kapilavatthu iddhañceva phītañca bāhujaññaṃ ākiṇṇamanussaṃ sambādhabyuhaṃ.
sn55.21:1.5: so khvāhaṃ bhante, bhagavantaṃ payirupāsitvā manobhāvanīyaṃ vā bhikkhuṃ, sāyanhasamayaṃ kapilavatthuṃ pavisanto;
sn55.21:1.11: tassa mayhaṃ bhante, tasmiṃ samaye mussateva bhagavantaṃ ārabbha sati. mussati dhammaṃ ārabbha sati mussati saṅghaṃ ārabbha sati.
sn55.21:1.13: “imamhi cāhaṃ samaye kālaṃ kareyyaṃ kā mamassa gati, ko abhisamparāyo”ti?
sn55.21:2.1: mā bhāyi mahānāma, mā bhāyi mahānāma,
sn55.21:2.2: apāpakaṃ te maraṇaṃ bhavissati, apāpikā kālakiriyā
sn55.21:2.3: yassa kassaci mahānāma, dīgharattaṃ saddhāparibhāvitaṃ cittaṃ, sīlaparibhāvitaṃ cittaṃ, sutaparibhāvitaṃ cittaṃ, cāgaparibhāvitaṃ cittaṃ, paññāparibhāvitaṃ cittaṃ, tassa yo hi khvāyaṃ kāyo rūpī cātummahābhūtiko mātāpettikasambhavo odanakummāsūpacayo aniccucchādanaparimaddanabhedanaviddhaṃsanadhammo.
sn55.21:2.4: taṃ idheva kākā vā khādanti, gijjhā vā khādanti, kulalā vā khādanti, supānā vā khādanti, sigālā vā khādanti, vividhā vā pāṇakajātā khādanti.
sn55.21:2.5: yañca khvassa cittaṃ dīgharattaṃ saddhāparibhāvitaṃ, sīlaparibhāvitaṃ, sutaparibhāvitaṃ, cāgaparibhāvitaṃ, paññāparibhāvitaṃ, taṃ uddhagāmī hoti visesagāmi.
sn55.21:3.1: seyyathāpi mahānāma, balavā puriso sappikumbhaṃ vā telakumbhaṃ vā gambhīraṃ udakarahadaṃ ogāhetvā bhindeyya.
sn55.21:3.2: tatra yāssa sakkharā vā kaṭhalā vā sā adhogāmī assa, yañca khvassa tatra sappi vā telaṃ vā taṃ uddhaṅgāmi assa visesagāmi.
sn55.21:3.3: evameva kho mahānāma, yassa kassaci dīgharattaṃ saddhāparibhāvitaṃ cittaṃ sīla …pe… suta …pe… cāga …pe…
sn55.21:3.4: paññāparibhāvitaṃ cittaṃ, tassa yo hi khvāyaṃ kāyo rūpī cātummahābhūtiko mātāpettikasambhavo odanakummāsūpacayo aniccucchādanaparimaddanabhedanaviddhaṃsanadhammo, taṃ idheva kākā vā khādanti, gijjhā vā khādanti, kulalā vā khādanti, supānā vā khādanti, sigālā vā khādanti, vividhā vā pāṇakajātā khādanti.
sn55.21:3.5: yañca khvassa cittaṃ saddhāparibhāvitaṃ …pe… paññāparibhāvitaṃ cittaṃ. taṃ uddhaṅgāmī hoti visesagāmī.
sn55.21:3.6: tuyhaṃ kho pana mahānāma, dīgharattaṃ saddhāparibhāvitaṃ cittaṃ …pe… paññāparibhāvitaṃ cittaṃ
sn55.21:3.7: mā bhāyi mahānāma, mā bhāyi mahānāma,
sn55.21:3.8: apāpakaṃ te maraṇaṃ bhavissati. apāpikā kālakiriyāti.
